CustomField.label: Expected Value
CustomField.description: The fixed value to compare against. Used only when Expected Value Comes From is "A fixed value". Can be text, a number, or a numeric threshold such as 0, 5, or 100000.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The value to compare against, e.g. 1, Approved, or San Francisco. For numeric checks, this can be the threshold. Only used when Expected Value Comes From is "A fixed value".
